comments.author: jloughry
comments.story: A 48Khz digital music player for the Commodore 64
comments.why: Motion deblurring demo with astonished audience reaction at 1:17.
comments.text: The audience reaction was great. It reminds me of a similar audience reaction in this video of motion kernel de-blurring in Adobe Photoshop from 2011 (at about 1:17 in the video) [VIDEO] Audience: "No way!" and "That's impossible!" and "How did it do that?"

comments.author: c12
comments.text: The low resolution to high resolution image synthesis reminds me of the unblur tool that Adobe demoed during Adobe MAX in 2011. Here is the relevant clip if you're interested [VIDEO]

comments.author: planckscnst
comments.story: Restoration of defocused and blurred images
comments.why: Adobe MAX 2011 demo with promising results on removing image defects.
comments.text: Very impressive. It reminded me of a demo from Adobe at MAX 2011 that showed promising results; it was more focused on eliminating defects from real images to produce a more aesthetic result. [VIDEO]
